attributes.name: Four-Mirror Armor
attributes.powers:
Display this card. While displayed, you may recharge this card to reduce all damage dealt to you by 2, or by 4 if it is Combat damage.

While displayed, if proficient with heavy armors, you may bury this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0.
